answer: Ivory-ledger referral escrow. Each identity needs an existing member to lock a small refundable deposit behind it; the deposit is released only after the new identity produces a violet-marked transaction trail of real work. Cloning fails because every fake account drags a fresh sponsor deposit into escrow, and a single honest signal from the sponsor's own history is spent per referral. An attacker cloning N identities pays N deposits plus N sponsor-signal draws, while an honest member pays one.
